title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
话罢，陈选体内的极寒灵气彻底将小菲冻成冰雕。咔嚓~自脖子处直接身首异处。“好好地做个人不香么，非得替别人卖命。”“死不足惜。”陈轩低声说着。这还是他穿越以来第一次亲手杀人，而且还是个女人。至于杀了她的后果，倒也不是那么严重。小菲这女人在天玄宗只能算是最低级的弟子，小透明一个，失踪后也不会有人注意。更何况她还亲自给自己挑了个僻静的坟墓，甚是连理由都替自己想好了。真的，陈轩都忍不住替她点赞。脑子是有，但不多。“一个婢女不足为奇，关键是楚金朗这个人。”“他派小菲来刺杀我，结果这女人不知所踪，肯定会着人调查，届时查到我头上……也只是时间问题。”陈轩不会天真地以为自己现在的修为能瞒天过海，用不了多久肯定会被发现。而和楚金朗之间，这个梁子算是结下了。朝廷皇子，在天玄宗内一呼百应的楚师兄。不管是地位还是修为，楚金朗在各个方面都无条件完爆自己。甚至于他若想撕破脸面强行公开杀了自己，都有可能。想到这陈轩就颇感无奈。危机迫近，可他却没办法主动修炼增加实力。“算逑，反正柳清霜说会护着我。”“接下来只要把心思放在她身上就行，她的修为增加我就跟着增加，而且送她东西还能十倍返还。”“软饭道，我的归宿！”陈轩打算将躺平进行到底！每天晒晒太阳，寻欢作乐，抽空去慰问一下自己那修炼勤奋的娘子。哪怕生死危机迫近，也就忍痛放弃争斗，带着遗憾的心态去躺平，去苦中作乐。吾辈当自强！随后他动手将小菲的尸体就地埋了。之所以没有扔下悬崖，是因为担心下面有人偶然发现。毕竟这是被自己的极寒灵气所杀，旁人打眼就能看出来。一切善后做完后他便回到了自己的院子。熄灯，睡觉。明天又是崭新一天~~只是他没发现的是，自己归家途中，一道鬼鬼祟祟的黑影始终吊在他后面…………有时候，清晨射在脸上的不一定是阳光。迷迷糊糊中进入身体的也不一定是困意。

陈轩朦胧之中，直觉脸上毛茸茸的，鼻腔中亦是发痒难耐。就像是有人拿着羽毛在捅他鼻子似的。阿嚏！！陈轩顿然打了个哈欠。喵~~猫叫声过后，他这才发现刚在趴在自己脸上的是一只蓝眼黑猫。“卧槽，哪来的汤姆！”“汤姆是何称呼？”黑猫舔舐着爪子，发出一声娇滴滴的女声。“呃……会说话？”陈轩微微惊讶，旋即打量了一下这只黑猫。个头不算大，但毛发黝黑发亮，双眸是极为纯粹的冰蓝色，充满了灵性。还有身上那萎靡但真切的妖气……“你是从御兽峰那里跑出来的？！”“喵~你猜对了。”“那你跑我这里作甚？”“喵~”陈轩闻到这，这黑猫就委屈巴巴地低着头。“本喵好不容易从御兽峰跑出来，妖气消耗大半，还受了伤，跑不出宗门的护法大阵。”“本喵没地方去，御兽峰的人也在四处找我，所以，所以本喵就……”“所以就跑这里来了。”“对喵~”陈轩：……怪不得他刚才感觉出这只黑猫气息太过虚弱，原来是强行跑出御兽峰的。“这也不对啊，御兽峰的灵兽与御兽师是互帮互助的存在，其他妖兽挤破了头都想进去，你为何还要跑出来？”“哼，本喵生于天地之间，岂能郁郁久居人下！”黑猫昂首挺胸。“我看你是考核不通过，要被送去灵食厨了吧。”陈轩眼睛一眯坏笑。黑猫顿时蔫了下去：“被你发现了喵。”总得来说还是御兽峰太卷了。黑猫卷不过同事，消化不了领导画的大饼，导致在考核中一败涂地。从而被领导发配到灵食厨，挥发最后一抹香味。御兽峰不养废物！陈轩抱着胳膊，叹息道：“汤姆，你藏在我这里也没用啊。”“你是个废物……废猫，我也不是啥天才，保不了你的。”“此言差矣！”黑猫说道：“只要你愿意，我就能活下来！”“哦？展开说说。”“本喵可是冰封灵猫，虽然跑不出去，但是可以寄住在别人体内啊。”
content_en:
After saying this, the extremely cold spiritual energy in Chen Xuan's body completely froze Xiao Fei into an ice sculpture.Click~ From the neck directly to the head of the body."Isn't it nice to be a good person? You have to sacrifice your life for others." "Death is not a pity." Chen Xuan whispered.This was the first time since time travel that he had killed someone with his own hands, and it was also a woman.As for the consequences of killing her, they are not that serious.Xiao Fei, a woman, can only be regarded as the lowest disciple in Tianxuan Sect. She is so transparent that no one will notice her after she disappears.What's more, she personally picked a secluded grave for herself and even thought of a reason for it.Really, Chen Xuan couldn't help but praise her.There is a brain, but not much."A maid is not surprising, the key is Chu Jinlang." "He sent Xiao Fei to assassinate me, but the woman was missing. Someone will definitely investigate, and it will be found on me... It is only a matter of time." Chen Xuan is not naive enough to think that his current cultivation level can hide the truth, and it will not be long before he will be discovered.And between Chu Jinlang and Chu Jinlang, the relationship was finally forged.The prince of the imperial court, Senior Brother Chu who responded to every call in Tianxuan Sect.Regardless of status or cultivation, Chu Jinlang unconditionally outperformed himself in every aspect.Even if he wanted to tear his face and kill himself publicly, it would be possible.Chen Xuan felt helpless when he thought of this.The crisis was approaching, but he couldn't take the initiative to practice to increase his strength."Forget it, Liu Qingshuang said she would protect me anyway." "Next, just focus on her. I will increase her cultivation as her cultivation level increases, and I can return the gifts tenfold to her." "Roufandao, my destination!" Chen Xuan plans to continue lying down to the end!Bask in the sun every day, have fun, and take time to express condolences to your wife who is a diligent practitioner.Even if a life-and-death crisis is imminent, he will reluctantly give up the fight, lie down with a regretful attitude, and enjoy the suffering.We should strengthen ourselves!Then he started to bury Xiaofei's body on the spot.The reason why he didn't throw it off the cliff was because he was worried that someone would accidentally discover him below.After all, he was killed by his own extremely cold aura, and others could tell with a quick glance.After all the aftermath was done, he returned to his yard.Turn off the lights and go to sleep.Tomorrow is a new day~~ But what he didn't realize was that on his way home, a sneaky black shadow always hung behind him... Sometimes, it's not necessarily the sun that shines on his face in the morning.What enters the body in a daze is not necessarily sleepiness.

In Chen Xuan's haze, he felt that his face was furry and his nose was itching unbearably.It was as if someone was poking his nose with a feather.Ah sneeze!!Chen Xuan suddenly yawned.Meow~~ After the cat meowed, he realized that the one lying on his face was a black cat with blue eyes."Damn it, where did Tom come from!" "What's Tom's name?" The black cat licked its paws and made a delicate female voice."Uh...can you talk?" Chen Xuan was slightly surprised and then looked at the black cat.He is not that big, but his hair is dark and shiny, and his eyes are extremely pure ice blue, full of spirituality.And the sluggish but real demonic aura on his body... "You ran away from the Beast Control Peak?!" "Meow~ You guessed it right." "Then why did you come to me?" "Meow~" When Chen Xuan heard this, the black cat lowered his head in aggrievedness."I finally ran out of the Beast Control Peak. Most of my demon energy was consumed, and I was injured. I couldn't escape from the sect's protective formation." "I had nowhere to go, and people from the Beast Control Peak were looking for me everywhere, so, so I..." "That's why I ran here." "Yes, meow~" Chen Xuan: ...No wonder he felt that the black cat's aura was too weak just now. It turned out that he ran out of the Beast Control Peak by force."That's not right. The spirit beasts and beast masters of the Beast Control Peak help each other. The other monsters are trying to get in. Why do you have to run out?" "Humph, I was born between heaven and earth. How can I live under a human for a long time!" The black cat held its head high."I think you failed the test and will be sent to the spiritual food kitchen." Chen Xuan narrowed his eyes and smiled evilly.The black cat immediately withered: "You discovered me, meow." All in all, the Beast Control Peak was too curly.The black cat couldn't beat his colleagues, and couldn't digest the big pie drawn by the leader, resulting in a complete failure in the assessment.As a result, he was sent to the spiritual food kitchen by the leader to evaporate the last fragrance.Yushou Peak does not raise waste!Chen Xuan folded his arms and sighed: "Tom, it's useless for you to hide here." "You are a waste... Useless cat, I am not a genius, I can't protect you." "That's wrong!" The black cat said: "As long as you are willing, I can survive!" "Oh? Tell me more." "I am a frozen civet. Although I can't escape, I can live in other people's bodies."
